links.comparator_used: Pathologists' own blinded first quantification of myocardial fibrosis without AI output (pre-AI vs post-AI reassessment)
links.outcome: Inter-observer agreement among pathologists in quantifying myocardial fibrosis on endomyocardial biopsies
links.effect: Pathologist agreement improved significantly and no longer depended on fibrosis severity. Before AI, discordance was relevant, especially at higher fibrosis percentages. Median fibrosis was 8.33% (first pathologist) vs 13.60% (algorithm), R2 0.79, p<0.001. No agreement statistics were given in the abstract.
links.quote: The knowledge of the automatic quantification significantly improved the overall pathologist´s agreement, which became unaffected by the degree of MF severity.

design_hint: revealing AI quantification to pathologists for reassessment (AI-assisted review)
